title: ZeParticles
description: A simple particle generator plugin with flexible settings.
body:
A simple particle generator plugin with flexible settings.
![ You can use any particles from Minecraft.](https://cloud.onlysq.ru/v2/files/ab4VdbfHtVVnww/stream?mode=view)
![ And combine them.](https://cloud.onlysq.ru/v2/files/jZDmN90qWJlkI3/stream?mode=view)
![ And adjust the odds.](https://cloud.onlysq.ru/v2/files/mUe7fie1zGAGws/stream?mode=view)

Commands:
/zparts
/zeparticles
You can:
Add new generator.
Delete generator.
Edit generator.
And see list of all generators.

This plugin allows you to add two or more particles, separated by a ",".
/zparts first,second,...
You can edit odds.
/zparts first%20,second%80
And you can edit flags like by --persecond (Count particles generated per second.)
/zparts CLOUD --persecond 5
And more other flags like by range (range for particles been generated.), timerand (by how many ticks the particle generation times will differ from one another.), and other. :P
